text: 香港财政司司长陈茂波表示，香港将维持港元与美元的联系汇率制度。陈茂波周三表示，港元与美元的联系汇率制度运作良好，并将继续维持。香港财政司司长陈茂波表示，随着人民币的国际使用预计将进一步扩大，香港正着力完善基础设施，以支持更多人民币产品的推出。（彭博）
text_en: Hong Kong Financial Secretary Paul Chan said Hong Kong will maintain the linked exchange rate system between the Hong Kong dollar and the US dollar. Chan said on Wednesday that the linked exchange rate system between the Hong Kong dollar and the US dollar is working well and will continue to be maintained. Hong Kong Financial Secretary Paul Chan said that as international use of the renminbi is expected to further expand, Hong Kong is focusing on improving infrastructure to support the launch of more renminbi products. (Bloomberg)
